rules.explicitLaterRatingWins: W48 decision.rating overrides the W48 originalRating, without destroying either. An empty decision.rating retains original rating and does not count as new user scoring.
rules.zeroToTwo: PERMANENT_REJECTION. Never show that original picture again; preserve only in historic audit ledger.
rules.three: NEEDS_RESEARCH. Preserve as insufficient, never count as selected.
rules.five: AESTHETICALLY_SELECTED. If a photo may depict different original than the source/title, bind human choice to the viewed image and hold nominal artwork identity instead of assigning that 5 to the wrong painting.
rules.fitElsewhere: A 5 artwork marked 'elsewhere' remains an aesthetic selection for another use; it does not close the listed saint's portrait/subject requirement.
rules.wrongIdentity: Wrong-identity flags block the subject assignment irrespective of numeric rating; not a globally rejected artwork absent 0–2.
rules.photoOriginalDedup: Multiple candidate IDs or saint placement rows may represent one physical original. Accession and actual image must be reconciled before counting independently.
rules.sourceRights: Final image master acquisition, provenance, attribution, attribution/crop rights and app integration are separately pending.
rules.scopeWarning: This is all 481 entries in W48 snapshot plus explicitly identified historical W37 portrait 5s, NOT a claim to reconcile every prior review not in those sources.
